verdict.rationale: Kino AI is an agent-driven video editor that exposes an MCP server, so skill authoring is a fair axis for it. However, nothing in the evidence mentions skills, skill folders, or the open Agent Skills specification. Its templates and MCP integration are adjacent features and earn no credit toward this story.

support.subject: As a developer, skills follow the open Agent Skills specification so the same skill folder is valid beyond this one vendor's tooling
